svg.title: Timestep-conditioned learnable fusion gates
svg.desc: The existing pretrained LTX MSA gate supplies conditioning to two independent learnable heads, which produce the local fusion weight alpha_1 and the local-global fusion weight alpha_2. The enclosing box is a grouping, not an additional shared trainable layer. The timestep-to-MSA arrow abstracts the existing timestep embedding and AdaLN path. Each head uses its own learned channel-wise affine parameters and a sigmoid; no extra timestep encoder is added.
